chunks: And how many a town have We destroyed that boasted of its livelihood? So those dwellings of theirs were not inhabited after them except rarely, and We were the inheritors.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the fate of prosperous but arrogant communities?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the transient nature of worldly wealth (ma'ishah) as a test of gratitude versus arrogance, illustrating how divine punishment often leaves ruins as signs for future generations. It reinforces the concept of Allah as the ultimate inheritor (Al-Warith), contrasting the fleeting power of earthly kingdoms with eternal divine sovereignty.
